verdict.rationale: Rippling ships an official CLI whose Flux commands create, manage and deploy Rippling-hosted integrations, alongside platform APIs and a developer sandbox, so scripted, non-UI automation is plausible. Nothing shows the CLI or APIs being used headlessly in CI pipelines, and the CLI appears scoped to integration developers rather than general product automation. Missing for 10: documented CI/headless usage, non-interactive auth (service tokens) for pipelines, CLI coverage of core HR/payroll operations, independent hands-on corroboration.
